description: This file contains unit tests for the PerformanceTrackerDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to saving performance trackers and checking reviewer status, using mocking and fixture setup.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PerformanceTrackerDao, testing performance tracker operations including persistence, reviewer checks, and updates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a PerformanceTrackerDao instance and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSavePerformanceTrackerWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests handling of exceptions during save operation, ensuring TransactionException is thrown when persistence fails.

methods.name: testIsTrackerReviewerWithNullEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as employee number returns false for isTrackerReviewer query.

methods.name: testUpdatePerformanceTrackerWithEmptyReviewerArray
methods.description: Checks that updating a performance tracker with an empty reviewer array returns the same tracker instance.
